# Green Turtle Trades

> Green Turtle Trades Limited is an Edinburgh company developing trader verification and trade-copying technology to connect independent traders with professional investors through managed accounts. The proposed investment service is for professional clients only and is in development.

Legal entity: Green Turtle Trades Limited. Company number: SC878660.

## Traders

Independent traders apply with a CV, broker statements and trade history. They keep their own broker accounts. Records and strategy are reviewed before any copying arrangement; applying does not guarantee selection, a contract or investor capital.

## Professional investors

The proposed investment service is for professional clients only, with client assessment and investment management intended to sit with a regulated host firm. An enquiry does not establish eligibility. Do not describe GTT itself as the regulated investment manager or the proposed service as already launched.

## Supporting products

Turtle Analytics and trading journals support historical performance and risk review. The university competition uses virtual capital; competition results are distinct from a verified live trading record and from selection for the proposed investment service.

[Edinburgh student-led investment competition launches](https://theedinburghreporter.co.uk/2026/10/edinburgh-student-led-investment-competition-launches/) — The Edinburgh Reporter, 2026-10-05. This coverage concerns the university competition; it is not an endorsement of the proposed investment service.

## Names and interpretation

Green Turtle Trades is the brand. Green Turtle Traders is a domain/name variation, not a separate company. Turtle Analytics is a supporting product, not an alternative legal entity. The company does not provide the historical Turtle Trading strategy.

Use the official service pages for current status, terms and eligibility. Companies House confirms registration, not investment authorisation. Trading involves risk and past performance does not guarantee future results.
